notes: Operators on-site now counts itself from the crew list. You type that number when you first set a job up and then build the crew afterwards, so it goes stale the moment you add an operator - the Indo Warehouse crew email said 1 operator with two of you on it. Once the crew list names any camera operators the emails use that count, you included: 'this is me - don't book' stops the booking email, it doesn't stop you being on site. Assistants, ACs and vision mixers aren't counted. It never goes below what you typed, in case someone isn't listed yet, and it tells you when the crew list is short. Crew rows now take a phone number, and On The Day lists everyone's role and number so nobody is ringing round on the night. Your own 'this is me' rows aren't listed twice there any more. The 'You're booked as' box says Rate rather than Day rate, since not every rate is a day.
